svg.text: Every net below is taken directly from vital_monitor.ino. Junction dot = connected. Hop over a wire = crossing, not connected.

g.text: pin 3 SET — leave open (idles high = run)
1. PMS5003 needs 5 V for its fan and laser. A 3.7 V cell alone will not run it — the MT3608 boost is mandatory, not optional.
2. GPIO9 is the ESP32-C3 BOOT strap pin. Keep its 4.7 kΩ pull-up to 3V3 fitted so the board does not fall into download mode at power-on.
3. GPIO20/21 are the UART0 pins. Set the Arduino IDE to "USB CDC On Boot: Enabled", or the PMS5003 will fight the serial monitor.
